# Poliora

> Poliora is a local-first AI cost control application for developers and technical teams.

## What it does

- Records AI usage metadata only when a person explicitly imports or connects a supported source.
- Compares approved model rates and helps teams test lower-cost routing decisions.
- Separates modeled savings from measured, realized savings.
- Runs its dashboard locally on the user's computer.

## Privacy boundary

Poliora does not collect prompts, model replies, source code, private transcripts, credentials, or provider account history by default. Poliora can review supported Codex and Claude Code usage metadata only after the person requests it. It does not read prompts, replies, source code, private transcripts, credentials, or provider account history.

## Supported workflow

Poliora can detect local Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and Antigravity launchers. It supports authorized CSV imports and supported API usage wrappers. Subscription activity is not converted into invented per-token cost.
